# Farmermarket

> Your complete directory of farmers markets across America. Find fresh, local produce and artisanal goods in your area with market hours, locations, and vendor information.

Farmermarket.us is a comprehensive directory of farmers markets across all 50 US states. Each market listing includes detailed information such as operating hours, exact locations with addresses, vendor information, and seasonal availability. The site helps users discover local farmers markets, support local agriculture, and find fresh produce in their area.

The directory is organized by state for easy navigation, with each state page showing all farmers markets in that region. Individual market pages provide detailed information including contact details, operating schedules, and vendor listings where available.

## Blog & Educational Content

The site features educational content about farmers markets, local food systems, and seasonal eating:

- [Blog](https://farmermarket.us/blog): Educational articles about farmers markets and local food

Here's how to pick perfectly ripe ones, ripen and store them right, and make the most of them before they're gone.
- [Blueberry Season Is Here: How to Buy, Store, and Savor June's Best Berry](https://farmermarket.us/blog/blueberry-season-farmers-market-2026): Blueberries hit their stride at farmers markets in June. - [Garlic Scapes: The Curly Green Mystery at Your June Farmers Market](https://farmermarket.us/blog/garlic-scapes-farmers-market-2026): Garlic scapes appear at farmers markets for just a few weeks in June. Here's what they are, how to pick them, and the best ways to cook the most fleeting allium of the season.
- [Fresh Cherries at the Farmers Market: Your Guide to the Shortest Season of Summer](https://farmermarket.us/blog/fresh-cherries-farmers-market-2026): Cherry season lasts just six weeks. Here's how to pick the best ones at your local farmers market, what to do with them before they're gone, and why the market cherries are worth the trip.
- [Summer Squash Season Is Here: Your Farmers Market Guide to Zucchini and Beyond](https://farmermarket.us/blog/summer-squash-farmers-market-guide-2026): Discover the best summer squash varieties at your farmers market this May, from classic zucchini to pattypan and zephyr. Plus tips on picking, storing, and cooking them.
- [Memorial Day Cookout from the Farmers Market: A 2026 Plan](https://farmermarket.us/blog/memorial-day-farmers-market-cookout-2026): Memorial Day weekend is two Saturdays away. Build the cookout from your local farmers market — the grill list, the sides, the dessert, and a Saturday game plan that actually works.
- [Mother's Day Brunch from the Farmers Market: A 2026 Guide](https://farmermarket.us/blog/mothers-day-farmers-market-brunch-2026): Skip the chain restaurant. Build a Mother's Day brunch from your local farmers market this Sunday — flowers, pastries, May produce, and a menu that comes together in 30 minutes.
- [Ramps: The Wild Spring Treasure You'll Only Find at Farmers Markets](https://farmermarket.us/blog/ramps-wild-spring-farmers-market-2026): Ramps season is short and sweet — late April through May. Here's why these foraged wild leeks have a cult following, where to find them, and how to use them sustainably.

- [Spring's Best-Kept Secret: The Farmers Market Finds You're Walking Past](https://farmermarket.us/blog/spring-hidden-gems-farmers-market-2026): While everyone reaches for asparagus and strawberries, these underrated spring farmers market finds — snap peas, radishes, and green garlic — deserve a spot in your bag.

Learn how to pick the best berries, store them right, and make the most of early strawberry season.
- [Spring Is Coming Earlier Than Ever — And Your Farmers Market Proves It](https://farmermarket.us/blog/spring-arrives-early-2026-farmers-market): Climate data shows spring is arriving weeks earlier across 84% of U.S. cities. - [The Hyper-Local Revolution: Why Farmers Markets Are More Important Than Ever](https://farmermarket.us/blog/hyperlocal-sourcing-spring-2026): Discover the latest trends shaping farmers markets in Spring 2026, from hyper-local sourcing to new USDA funding and the seasonal produce you should be looking for.

- [Spring Awakening: The First Fresh Finds at Your Farmers Market](https://farmermarket.us/blog/spring-awakening-first-fresh-finds): As winter fades, farmers markets burst back to life with tender greens, crisp radishes, and early spring vegetables. Here is what to look for and how to make the most of spring's first harvest.
- [First Signs of Spring: What to Find at Your Farmers Market in March](https://farmermarket.us/blog/spring-produce-march-2026): Spring is almost here! Discover the first seasonal vegetables and fruits making their way to farmers markets this March — from tender asparagus to sweet peas.
- [Move Over, Cottage Cheese: Farmer's Cheese Is the Ingredient You Need in 2026](https://farmermarket.us/blog/farmers-cheese-2026-trend): This creamy, versatile dairy product is having a major moment—and your farmers market is the best place to find it. Discover why farmer's cheese is replacing cottage cheese on tables everywhere.
- [Red, White & Fresh: July 4th Recipes Straight from Your Farmers Market](https://farmermarket.us/blog/july-4th-farmers-market-recipes): Celebrate Independence Day with farm-fresh ingredients! - [Ferry Plaza Farmers Market](https://farmermarket.us/california/ferry-plaza-farmers-market): San Francisco's premier farmers market featuring local vendors
- [Santa Monica Farmers Market](https://farmermarket.us/california/santa-monica-farmers-market): California's famous Santa Monica farmers market
- [Pike Place Market](https://farmermarket.us/washington/pike-place-market): Seattle's iconic Pike Place Market
